verdict.rationale: Drata documents its own Monitoring Tests: the API covers listing, creating custom, getting, updating, and excluding tests, and the product pitches monitoring of controls, evidence, and personnel. Its agent checks endpoint security settings, and a community report confirms that users appear as noncompliant in the dashboard. Nothing in the pack states how often tests run or that failures surface within hours, so the continuous, hours-scale part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented test cadence or continuous-run frequency, evidence of failing-control alerting latency (within hours), in-depth first-party monitoring docs beyond titles, and independent hands-on corroboration of detection speed.

support.subject: As a security engineer, automated tests run continuously against my connected systems — failing controls surface within hours, not at the annual audit
